Commission Library
Common structures used in insurance & benefits sales — click any to build it with Ace
Tiered Commission
Accelerates as reps close more
$0 – $50K 6%
$50K – $100K 8%
$100K+ 10%
Best for motivating top performers. Higher tiers kick in once reps hit milestones, rewarding consistent closers.
Most Popular Build with Ace →
Flat Rate
Simple, consistent percentage
All closed deals 7%
Manager override 1.5%
Easiest to explain to reps. Everyone earns the same percentage regardless of deal size. Great for newer teams.
Easiest to Run Build with Ace →
Goal-Based Bonus
Base rate + bonus at 100% goal
Base rate 6%
At 100% of goal +2% bonus
At 120%+ of goal +4% bonus
Ties commission to monthly targets. Reps earn more when they hit or exceed goal, creating a natural push at month-end.
High Motivator Build with Ace →
Residual / Recurring
Ongoing % on renewals & retained accounts
New sale commission 8%
Annual renewal 3%
Common in insurance and benefits. Reps earn on renewals, incentivizing long-term client relationships and account retention.
Insurance Favorite Build with Ace →
Split Commission
Shared credit between two reps
Primary rep 60%
Assisting rep 40%
For deals that require two reps to close. Manager sets the split ratio. Encourages collaboration without disputes.
Team Selling Build with Ace →
Accelerator
Rate climbs as quota attainment climbs
Up to 100% of quota 5%
Beyond 150% of quota 12%
Rewards overachievement. Rate bands are based on % of quota attained rather than deal size, so it scales with each rep's target.
Overachiever Favorite Build with Ace →
Draw Against Commission
Guaranteed floor while ramping
Monthly draw $3,000
Underlying rate 7%
Common for new hires ramping up. A guaranteed advance is paid each period, which earned commissions pay back first.
New Hire Ramp Build with Ace →
Product-Based
Different rates per product line
New licenses 10%
Renewals 3%
Weights payout by what's sold. Lets you push new logos harder than renewals, or reward high-margin add-ons.

How is our Q2 performance tracking compared to last year?
2h ago
Performance Comparison
MetricQ2 2025Q2 2026Change
Total Sales$6.72M$7.95M+18.3%
Win Rate52%58%+6pp
Avg Deal Size$38K$42K+10.5%
Team ROI241%285%+44pp
Key Takeaways
  • Sales are tracking 18.3% ahead of Q2 2025, the team is accelerating.
  • Win rate improved from 52% to 58%, indicating stronger proposal quality and follow-up cadence.
  • Average deal size grew by $4K, likely driven by Brock Wilson's enterprise focus in March–May.
Recommendations
  • Maintain current call volume, the team is 8% above Q2 2025 call count.
  • Coach Jules Richards on deal velocity, her avg close time is 22 days vs team avg of 14.
  • Replicate Brock's discovery call framework across the team to sustain deal size growth.
Conclusion

Q2 2026 is your strongest quarter on record. Sustaining current momentum puts you on pace for $16.2M EOY, 84% of annual goal. Three focused advisors can close the remaining gap with a strong H2 push.
